title: Stop Crossing Your Arms When Turning (Part 2)
hook: Part two! Keep your hands right.

script.narration: Part two! Keep your hands right.
script.visual_search: driver hands on steering wheel close up

script.narration: Use the push and pull method. One hand pushes up to the top, and the other hand pulls down.
Your hands never cross over the center of the steering wheel. This gives you maximum control and safety in sharp turns.
Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Do you use push and pull steering? Comment yes or no. Part two! Keep your hands right.
